minutes.headline: Board voted on Conway's Flat Hill solar permit after a third hearing; the result is unclear in the captions
minutes.summary: The board continued the Highfield Village hearing to February 9, 2015 at the applicant's request, then heard committee reports and discussed the Village District bylaw and master plan workshops. Most of the night was the third hearing on a ground-mounted solar permit at 322 Flat Hill Road, with abutters and their attorney opposed. The board closed the hearing, amended a motion to approve with conditions, and voted, but the tally is unclear in the captions. The board then agreed Pleasant Street could keep its utility poles via a letter and field change.

public_comment.topic: Called the applicant's statements disingenuous and warned of a precedent for solar farms in town.
Disputed the applicant's account of the November 6 meeting, objected to the proposed size, asked for an independent noise study, raised child safety and asked for denial.
Asked whether the plans match those before the zoning board, and criticised the noise calculation as a back-of-envelope estimate.
Said approval would undermine the solar bylaw, and raised open meeting law concerns about a board member's letter.
Corrected the record on who attended the meeting and called the applicant's ten kilowatt fallback an ultimatum.
Said approval would undo the bylaw's idea of small projects and asked the board to disallow it.
Accepted the utility poles at Pleasant Street solar, and raised concerns about vegetation screening and the solar bylaw.

decisions.decision: The Village District bylaw review will go on the November 24 agenda, with members emailing comments to the planner beforehand.
The planner will reach out individually to other boards for master plan economic development input instead of holding another workshop.
Pleasant Street solar will submit a letter on the utility pole change, to be accepted as an administrative field change at a December meeting.
The planner will write a policy requiring applicant submissions by Thursday before the Monday meeting, for the board to adopt later.

what_happened.line: The board closed the third hearing on a ground-mounted solar permit at 322 Flat Hill Road, after abutters and their attorney spoke against it.
The board then amended a motion to approve with conditions and voted on it, but the captions do not make the tally clear.
The applicant's request to withdraw the application was raised during deliberation; the captions do not show how it was settled.
The Highfield Village public hearing was continued to February 9, 2015, at the applicant's request.
Pleasant Street solar will send a letter on its utility pole change, to be accepted as an administrative field change at a December meeting.

why_it_matters: The Flat Hill outcome decides whether a ground-mounted solar project of this size can be built next to homes under the town's solar bylaw, and it may set a precedent for later projects.
Because the tally is unclear in the captions, the official minutes or the recording are needed to confirm whether the permit was approved, and on what conditions.
watch_next: November 24 meeting: Village District bylaw review, with members emailing comments to the planner beforehand.
A December meeting: the Pleasant Street solar letter on the utility pole change is due to be accepted as a field change.
